_meta.note: Inject this file as system context before AI briefing generation. These are ground-truth facts, not model memory.

ron95_subsidy.detail: BUDI95 launched in phases September 27–30, 2025. Subsidised RON95 at RM1.99/L with 300L/month quota for eligible households. Unsubsidised RON95 market price is RM3.72/L (June 2026).
ron95_subsidy.budimentari: BUDI Individu (personal) and BUDI Keluarga (family) streams launched 2025-09-27

diesel_subsidy.detail: Peninsula Malaysia diesel subsidy removed June 10, 2024. Float price as of June 2026 is RM4.37/L. Sabah and Sarawak still subsidised at RM2.15/L.

fomc_schedule_2026.note: All dates are publicly scheduled FOMC meetings. Briefings must NEVER report outcomes before these dates.

q2_2026.detail: Q2 2026 advance estimate released by DOSM at 5.8%. BNM does not release advance GDP estimates. BNM's role is monetary policy and OPR.

opr.detail: Bank Negara Malaysia Overnight Policy Rate at 3.00%. Last changed May 2023. No change since.

monetary_policy_committee.frequency: 6 times per year (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov)

merdeka_center_june_2026.note: 52% is Anwar's approval rating. 42% is the separate 'country moving in right direction' metric. These are two different survey questions, not interchangeable.
merdeka_center_june_2026.source: Merdeka Center National Public Opinion Survey, June 2026

last_actual_settle_july19_2026.note: Last weekly close before July 19. Brent did NOT trade at $90.67 on July 19 — markets were closed (Sunday). $90.50 was the futures screen at time of writing, not a settled price.

cpi_june_2026.note: June 2026 CPI at 2.1% YoY is plausible but unconfirmed via official release. Core inflation was stable.

institutional_roles.dosm: Department of Statistics Malaysia — releases GDP advance estimates, CPI, employment data
institutional_roles.bnm: Bank Negara Malaysia — sets OPR, releases monetary policy statements, financial stability reports
institutional_roles.kpdn: Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living — oversees price controls, subsidies
institutional_roles.mof: Ministry of Finance — budget, fiscal policy
